title: Smoothness-Regularized 20-Layer Chirped DBR with Bounded Chirp Envelope
scientific_hypothesis: Adding a gradient smoothness penalty (lambda ~0.1) to the objective function targeting adjacent layer thickness differences will suppress the erratic thickness jumps observed in iteration_13 candidates while preserving the coherent phase-matching structure, leading to improved robustness without sacrificing target score.
design_principle: Chirped dielectric mirror with smoothness regularization to maintain monotonic or gently varying thickness progression that supports broadband reflection in 400-700 nm while maintaining transmission window at 1530-1565 nm.
proposed_topology: Air | [HfO2, SiO2] x10 | Fused Silica substrate (20 finite layers total, starting with HfO2)
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds initialized near iteration_13 winning pattern: odd layers 45-90 nm, even layers 65-130 nm with ±10% chirp envelope
theory_basis: Chirped DBR theory for broadband reflection
Regularization theory for smooth optimization trajectories
expected_advantages: Reduced thickness variance improves manufacturing tolerance
Smooth chirp maintains phase coherence across reflection band
Better convergence stability compared to unregularized gradient optimization
known_risks: Over-regularization may trap optimizer in suboptimal local minimum
Smoothness constraint may limit achievable reflection bandwidth
execution_request_english: Design and optimize a 20-layer HfO2/SiO2 chirped dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (alternating, 10 pairs, starting with HfO2). Optimize all 20 layer thicknesses using gradient-based optimizer with smoothness regularization penalty (lambda = 0.1) applied to adjacent thickness differences. Initialize thickness bounds: odd-indexed layers (HfO2) 45-90 nm, even-indexed layers (SiO2) 65-130 nm, with ±10% chirp envelope around linear progression. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized or both TE/TM. Spectral bands: 400-700 nm (maximize reflectance), 1530-1565 nm (maximize transmittance). Total layer count fixed at 20. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Added smoothness regularization penalty and chirp-constrained initialization bounds per feedback directives to address erratic thickness jumps in iteration_13 candidates while preserving the ~0.919 target score achievement.
